title: Fabric mill price quote to the factory: numbers and dates, but no buyer order
subject: Quotation – single jersey 160 GSM
body:
Dear Karthik,

As requested, our quotation for combed cotton single jersey:

- 160 GSM, 30s combed, open width: INR 385 per kg
- Minimum quantity: 2,000 kg per colour
- Colours: White, Black, Heather Grey (melange)
- Delivery: 21 days from confirmed order, ex-mill Tiruppur

Prices are valid until 31/12/2026. Please confirm by email if you want us to block capacity.

Regards,
R. Senthil
Kaveri Knit Fabrics Pvt. Ltd.
